_comment: Atlas Growth AU :: THIRD RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv — the LOW-RATED track (PROPOSED at the 2026-09-20 Maps probe, operator decision at GATE 1). Measured on the 305 probe rows: the review floor of 5 dropped 28 Australian rows as too_small and 21 of them are plainly real trade firms with 1-4 reviews — Eastern Restumping and Underpinning (2), MR Reblocking, Restumping and House Underpinning (2, typed 'Foundation'), C S Volk Reblocking (2), Expert Reblocking & Underpinning (3), SIMON REBLOCKING AND UNDERPINNING (4), Shepparton Restumping (1), State Wide Reblocking & Underpinning (3), Precise Restumping & Underpinning (4), Getting Dirty Restumping and Underpinning (2). In Victoria the 1-4 band is NOT the ghost band it was in the UK: restumping is a low-review trade. This pass keeps the floor of 5 as the ghost filter for nameless generic pins and takes back exactly the rows that carry all three of: 1-4 reviews (not blank — the unrated pass owns blanks), a live website, and an ICP token in the NAME. Deterministic, $0. Run AFTER the other two: qualify-leads.js --in <run>/excluded_officp.csv --config recover-lowrated-au-config.json --out <run>/recover-lowrated, then append (dedupe on place_id; assert zero overlap with the main pass and the other two recoveries). ALTERNATIVE the operator may prefer: lower the main floor to 1 and delete this file — same effect for ICP-named rows, but it also admits 1-4-review rows with generic names, which this pass refuses.

qualify_rules._r: 0. RECOVERY SCOPE GATE — one drop reason only, 'too_small'. A row removed by a deny or by the positive allow is refused before any other rule is read. Read the WARN line if pointed at a file without drop_reason.
qualify_rules.label: not_a_lowrated_candidate

qualify_rules._r: 1. RATED, not blank: the unrated pass owns blank review_count. qualify-leads.js treats a blank as failing any numeric comparison, so `>= 1` keeps exactly the 1-4 band here (5+ never reached this file).
qualify_rules.label: unrated_not_lowrated

qualify_rules._r: 2. A LIVE WEBSITE — the same substitute signal the unrated pass demands. Facebook-only rows are admitted here and routed to the no-website track by collapse-domains.js downstream.
qualify_rules.label: no_website

qualify_rules._r: 3. The NAME must claim the work — the precision half. Same token list as recover-generic-au-config.json rule 2 (kept in step by hand; brand terms included so a low-review licensee is not stranded).
qualify_rules.label: name_not_icp
